clock_policy.boss_rule: MAIN_BOSS freezes visible run clock, wave clock, XP progression and ordinary spawning from intro through settlement; MINI_BOSS keeps those clocks and ordinary spawning advancing. A separate encounter clock advances for both kinds.

enemy_variant_policy.visual_rule: Each ordinary visual variant has a readable detail plus palette marker; color alone is invalid.
enemy_variant_policy.reward_rule: Variants inherit base XP, drop and aftermath boundary unless B1 explicitly overrides it.

pending_values.reason: B1 values stop before the new late-run bands; architecture stores references only.
Catalog IDs and active limit are fixed; weights, phases and numbers belong to Balance.
Asset linkage and artistic approval are outside this write scope.
A non-final chest needs a fallback outcome, but exact value and copy are not supplied.
The baseline percentage exists; rounding for odd amounts is absent.
Artifact effects remain run modifiers separate from build slots.
Cost, currency and refresh limit are not canonical.
Duplicate and stacking behavior is not canonical.
Snapshot restore and abandon behavior need product/runtime approval.
Runtime migration adapter is outside this architecture folder.

wave_policy.post_boss_rule: Every non-final encounter enters relief before gradual ramp; no direct jump to peak.

artifact_effects.source: product decision; examples are documented in GAME_MANIFEST.md

reward_bundles.source: 30-minute extension; post-result artifact offer remains separate

id_policy.rule: IDs are stable semantic slugs; display labels are localized and never used as keys.
id_policy.unknown_ids: Quarantine optional records; block authoritative run restore.

invariants: UI never owns authoritative run state.
RunSession is the source of truth for an active run.
Content Registry is immutable and versioned during a run.
XP drops and aftermath items are separate entity types.
MAIN_BOSS freezes visible run clock, wave clock, XP progression and ordinary spawning from intro through settlement.
MINI_BOSS keeps visible run clock, wave clock, XP progression and ordinary spawning advancing; the separate encounter clock advances for both kinds.
Final victory requires authoritative defeat of boss_black_moon_empress at the terminal schedule slot.
The terminal encounter creates no chest; first-clear artifact offer is a separate post-result boundary.
Every non-final main or mini encounter has one typed BOSS_CHEST window; five additional typed ELITE_CHEST windows remain reserved for Balance cadence.
Every artifact offer contains exactly three candidates and one chosen candidate becomes one active run effect.
Active artifacts do not consume weapon or passive slots and have no fixed run capacity.
Variants inherit the base XP, drop and aftermath boundary unless B1 explicitly overrides it.
The three beetle records require a non-color marker and do not create a second XP or aftermath boundary.
The ordinary registry has ten records; the elite catalog has ten records; at most five elite records enter the run projection; two legacy records are compatibility-only.
Rewards are committed atomically with the corresponding wallet or unlock revision.
Unknown numeric values remain pending until confirmed by B1.
Unknown product rules remain pending until confirmed by the product owner.
Missing resource errors produce diagnostics, never a blank screen.
Non-final chest, artifact and terminal result effects are idempotent.
Legacy snapshots cannot be silently reinterpreted as the v3 30-minute run.
Every non-final encounter enters post-boss relief before the next wave ramp.
Content and events carry registry IDs, encounter kind and state revision so replay cannot duplicate XP or aftermath.
